conventions.bbox: [x0, y0, x1, y1], fractions of the PDF page (A4, incl. the white frame around the scan)

drawings.description: au bas de la page, esquisse d'une matrice par blocs : un bloc identité en haut à gauche (indice $i$ marqué au-dessus), des zéros au-dessous, suivie d'un second bloc à peine indiqué ; précédée d'un mot \ill{}.
drawings.kind: sketch of a block matrix
drawings.notes: Sketch only: an illegible word, a colon, then a large parenthesis; inside, a first block bracketed by corner strokes with a diagonal stroke (the identity), the index i above it, a 0 below; to the right a second small block barely indicated (a small bracketed square) and a colon. The strokes are drawn as on the page.

drawings.description: matrice par blocs de $\sigma_i$, $(n+2)\times(n+2)$ : bloc identité d'ordre $i-1$ en haut à gauche ; bloc $2\times 2$ $\begin{pmatrix}0&1\\1&0\end{pmatrix}$ aux places $i,i+1$ ; à droite, sur les lignes $1$ à $i+1$, les coefficients $\lambda_{i1}\ \lambda_{i1}\cdots\lambda_{i1}$, \ldots, $\lambda_{ii}\cdots\lambda_{ii}$, $\lambda_{i,i+1}\cdots\lambda_{i,i+1}$ ; sur les $n-i$ dernières lignes, la diagonale $\lambda_{i,i+2}$ ; dernière colonne de translation nulle, $1$ en bas à droite. Les accolades marquent « $i-1$ », « $2$ », « $n-i$ », « $i+1$ ».
drawings.kind: block matrix of sigma_i (written out)
drawings.notes: The matrix of sigma_i written as an array: identity block of order i-1 (1, dots, 1), the block (0 1 / 1 0) at places i, i+1, a large 0 below it; to the right the rows lambda_{i1} ... lambda_{i1}, ..., lambda_{ii} ... (overinked), lambda_{i,i+1} ..., then the diagonal lambda_{i,i+2}; last column 0 ... 0, 1 at the bottom right; braces i-1, 2, n-i on the left and i+1, n-i on the right. Entries are placed as text in their positions; the overinked row is given as the transcription reads it.

drawings.description: matrice par blocs de $\sigma_i$ : identité d'ordre $i-1$ en haut à gauche ; bloc $\begin{pmatrix}0&1\\1&0\end{pmatrix}$ aux places $i,i+1$, suivi sur ces deux lignes de $-(1+\alpha_i)\ \cdots\ -(1+\alpha_i)$ et $(1+\alpha_i)\ \cdots\ (1+\alpha_i)$ ; identité sur le reste de la diagonale ; dernière colonne $(0,\dots,0,1)$. Plusieurs entrées retouchées.
drawings.kind: block matrix of sigma_i (written out)
drawings.notes: sigma_i = ( identity block (1, dots), the block (0 1 / 1 0) at places i, i+1 followed on these rows by -(1+alpha_i) ... -(1+alpha_i) and (1+alpha_i) ... (1+alpha_i); identity on the rest of the diagonal (dots, 1, 1); last column 0, ..., 0, 1; a large 0 above the right block ), inside a system brace on the left. Several entries retouched (overinked strokes on the left edge and the last column): placed as text in their positions.

drawings.description: petit schéma d'indices : $i-1$ ; $i$, $i+1\leq\ \leq j-1$, $j+1$ ; $j\geq i+2$ ; puis un $i$ isolé.
drawings.kind: schema of indices
drawings.notes: Indices written in a row: i-1, then i and i+1 with a stroke and "<= ... <= j-1", j+1; under it, written vertically, j >= i+2; then an isolated i to the right. Placed as text at their positions (the small figures are overinked).

drawings.description: figure : le sommet $s_0$ d'où partent les arêtes $a_0$ (vers $s_1$), $a_1$ (vers $s_2$), $a_2$ (vers $s_3$, vers le haut) et une quatrième arête vers le bas, aboutissant à un point marqué $s_3$ (surchargé) ; les faces $f_0$ (entre $a_0$ et $a_1$, hachurée), $f_1$ (entre $a_2$ et $a_0$, hachurée), $f_2$ (sous $a_1$) et $f_3$ au-delà de $s_1$ ; une arête $a_2^0$ issue de $s_1$.
drawings.kind: vertex with edges and faces (flags)
drawings.notes: Vertex s_0 with the edges a_0 (to s_1), a_1 (to s_2), a_2 (up) and a fourth edge down to a point marked s_3 (overwritten); faces f_1 (between a_2 and a_0, hatched by short strokes), f_0 (between a_0 and a_1, short hatching under a_0 and over a_1), f_2 (under a_1), f_3 beyond s_1 (hatched); from s_1 the edge a_2^0. Hatching drawn as short strokes as on the page.

drawings.description: deux petites figures : un segment à deux sommets marqués ; une courbe fermée portant un seul sommet.
drawings.kind: segment with two vertices; closed curve with one vertex
drawings.notes: A short vertical segment with a marked point at each end; a closed curve (ellipse) carrying one marked point.

drawings.description: un sommet $e$ d'où partent une arête vers un autre sommet et une flèche $f$ ; à côté, l'image de la situation en $\gamma e$.
drawings.kind: vertex with an edge and an arrow
drawings.notes: Vertex e with an edge (a curved stroke) to another vertex and an arrow f; beside it, gamma e with a long thin arc, the image of the situation.

drawings.description: à gauche, trois petites figures : une arête orientée de $e$ vers $e'$ ; une arête issue de $\gamma e$ ; une boucle en un sommet, avec une flèche sortante.
drawings.kind: three small figures: oriented edges and a loop
drawings.notes: An oriented edge from e to e'; an arrow from gamma e; a loop at a vertex with an outgoing arrow. The arrow diagram (Gamma -> G ...) to the right of them is text and is not drawn.

drawings.description: page de figures seules, reprenant celle de la p.~52 : en haut, un digone hachuré (deux arêtes joignant deux sommets) et un triangle à trois sommets marqués ; à droite, le sommet $s_0$ avec les arêtes $a_0$ (vers $s_1$), $a_1$ (vers $s_2$), $a_2$ (vers $s_3$) et les faces $f_0$, $f_1$ ; au centre, la figure développée : de $s_0$ partent $a_0$ vers $s_1$, $a_1$ vers $s_2$, $a_2$ vers $s_3$ et une quatrième arête vers le bas ; faces $f_0$ (hachurée, entre $a_0$ et $a_1$), $f_1$ (entre $a_2$ et $a_0$), $f_2$ (sous $a_1$), $f_3$ au-delà de $s_1$, et en $s_1$ l'arête $a_2'$. Le reste de la page est blanc.
drawings.kind: page of figures: digon, triangle, vertex stars
drawings.notes: Top: a hatched digon (two arcs joining two vertices), a triangle with three marked vertices; right, the small star of s_0 (edges a_0 to s_1, a_1 to s_2, a_2 to s_3, a line through s_0, faces f_0, f_1 hatched); centre, the developed figure: from s_0 the edges a_0 to s_1, a_1 to s_2, a_2 up to s_3 (arrow), a fourth edge down (arrow); faces f_0 (hatched by short strokes near s_0), f_1, f_2, f_3 beyond s_1, and at s_1 the edge a_2'. The rest of the page is blank. The small star is schematic.

drawings.description: Figure autour du drapeau $(s_0, a_0)$ : l'arête $s_0 s_1$ (marquée $a_0$), le triangle $s_0 s_1 s_2$ et ses images ; les sommets $s_2$, $s_3$, $s'_2$, $s'_3$ et, en pointillé à gauche, $s''_3$ ; les réflexions $\sigma_0$, $\sigma_1$, $\sigma_2$ sont marquées sur les droites qu'elles fixent.
drawings.kind: flag figure: triangle and its reflected images
drawings.notes: Around the flag (s_0, a_0): the edge s_0 s_1 (a_0, thick), the triangle s_0 s_1 s_2, s'_2 above s_1 (thick edge), arrows from s_0 to s_3 and from s_1 to s'_3, and dashed to the left to s''_3. The centre is heavily overinked: the reflections sigma_0, sigma_1, sigma_2 marked on the lines they fix are placed after the transcription; a second s'_3 label is visible under s_1.

drawings.description: Petit schéma : le carré $s_0 s_1 s'_2 s_2$ vu de face, avec $s_3$, $s'_3$ en dessous et $s''_3$ à gauche relié en pointillé.
drawings.kind: square seen from the front with neighbouring vertices
drawings.notes: The square s_0 s_1 s'_2 s_2 seen face on (two verticals and a horizontal; the triangle in its upper left corner inked solid), s_3, s'_3 below as dashed strokes, s''_3 at the left joined to the square by a full stroke and a dashed one. The label s_2 is not legible.

drawings.description: Deux croquis d'axes : à gauche, un trièdre $U, V, W$ avec un plan hachuré et des traces de la quadrique ; à droite, un trièdre $u, V, W$ seul. Des courbes (hyperboles, une sinusoïde tracée à travers les formules biffées) accompagnent.
drawings.kind: two coordinate trihedra with a quadric and curves
drawings.notes: Left: a trihedron (U horizontal, W vertical, V oblique) with a hatched plane (scribbled hatching) and pencil traces of the quadric; an S-shaped curve beside it. Right: a trihedron u, V, W alone. A sinusoid is drawn through the struck formulas at the top right, and hyperbola arcs near the formulas. The formulas are text and are not drawn. Schematic.

drawings.description: Icosaèdre en perspective : au centre le triangle $s_0 s_1 s_2$ (avec $\sigma_1$, $\sigma_0$, $\sigma_2$ marqués sur ses droites), autour les sommets $s_3$, $s'_3$, $s''_3$ et les antipodes $\mathbf{a}s_0$, $\mathbf{a}s_1$, $\mathbf{a}s_2$, $\mathbf{a}s_3$, $\mathbf{a}s'_3$, $\mathbf{a}s''_3$ ; arêtes cachées en pointillé.
drawings.kind: icosahedron in perspective
drawings.notes: Icosahedron: the central triangle s_0 s_1 s_2 (thick; sigma_1, sigma_0, sigma_2 written on its lines), around it s_3, s'_3, s''_3 and the antipodes a s_0, a s_1, a s_2, a s_3, a s'_3, a s''_3; hidden edges dashed. Which dashed strokes join which antipodes is a reading of broken strokes: the outer edges are schematic, not encoded.

drawings.description: Seconde figure : l'icosaèdre projeté dans le triangle $\bar s_1, \bar s_0, \bar s_2$, avec au centre $s_0, s_1, s_2, s_3, s'_3, s''_3$, $\bar s_3$, $\bar s'_3$, $\bar s''_3$ ; esquisse au crayon dessous.
drawings.kind: icosahedron projected in a triangle
drawings.notes: The icosahedron projected into the triangle s-bar_1, s-bar_0, s-bar_2 (outer sides curved); inside, the hexagram of s_0, s_1, s_2, s_3, s'_3, s''_3 around the centre and the points s-bar'_3, s-bar''_3 on the sides; a pencil sketch (a long curve) below it. Inner edges schematic.

drawings.description: Petit croquis en marge : le rectangle d'or de sommets $s_1$, $s_0$, $-s_0$, $-s_1$, côtés $x$ et $y$.
drawings.kind: golden rectangle
drawings.notes: Rectangle s_1, s_0 (top), -s_0, -s_1 (bottom), with the two axes crossing it; side labels x (on the axis) and y (top). Strokes drawn heavily.

drawings.description: petit rectangle à flèches, figurant une arête et une coarête.
drawings.kind: small rectangle with arrows
drawings.notes: A small rectangle with arrows on three sides (top and bottom to the right, right side upwards): an edge and a co-edge.

drawings.description: Croquis : un parallélogramme de sommets $s_0$, $s'_1$, $s_1$, $s_0$ autour d'un point $c$, deux vecteurs issus de $c$ ; à côté, « $x^2+y^2$ » biffé.
drawings.kind: parallelogram around a point with two vectors
drawings.notes: Parallelogram s'_0 (top), s'_1 (right), s_0 (bottom), s_1 (left) around a point c (a dot), with two vectors: from c to the right, and a long one down to the left ending in an arrow. Labels as read on the crop (the transcription reads s_0, s'_1, s_1, s_0); "x^2+y^2" struck at the right is text, not drawn. The inner strokes are a reading.
drawings.disagreement: the top vertex reads s'_0 on the crop, where the transcription has s_0 twice

drawings.description: en haut à gauche, un polyèdre (icosaèdre ?) dont une face triangulaire porte les sommets $s_0, s_1, s_2$ ; au-dessous, un triangle $s_0 s_1 s_2$ avec sa hauteur issue de $s_2$ et les médianes, les régions marquées $\sigma_0, \sigma_1, \sigma_2$ ; en tirets, les sommets voisins $s_3$ (sous $s_0 s_1$), $s'_3$ (à gauche) et $s''_3$ (à droite)
drawings.kind: polyhedron; triangle with altitude and medians
drawings.notes: Top: a polyhedron (icosahedron?) seen as a pentagonal outline with edges from an inner vertex, one triangular face s_0 s_1 s_2 drawn heavily. Below: the triangle s_0 s_1 s_2 with the altitude from s_2 and medians, regions marked sigma_0, sigma_1, sigma_2; dashed, the neighbouring vertices s_3 (under s_0 s_1), s'_3 (left) and s''_3 (right). The polyhedron's edges are a reading.

drawings.description: petit croquis biffé : $T$, $S$, $\Omega$ reliés par des traits.
drawings.kind: square of T, S, Omega (fibre product)
drawings.notes: Upside down on the page (the page is written tete-beche; crop rotated). T x_S Omega -> T, T -> S (arrow), Omega -> S (arrow), and a stroke from T x_S Omega down to Omega; a blot (struck sign) before the second Omega. The transcription says struck; only that blot is struck on the crop.
drawings.orientation: upside down on the page (tete-beche half); crop rotated 180 degrees, redraw upright, coordinates in the rotated crop

drawings.description: À droite, un polygone régulier (hexagone ou heptagone) dont un sommet et les deux arêtes qui en partent sont repassés en gras, avec un rayon vers le centre ; au-dessous, un cube en perspective où un drapeau (sommet, arête, face) est marqué en gras, avec trois droites étiquetées $\sigma_0$, $\sigma_1$, $\sigma_2$. À côté, la chaîne
drawings.kind: regular polygon with a bold vertex; cube with a flag
drawings.notes: Right: a regular polygon (drawn as a hexagon) whose top two strokes to the centre are bold (a vertex, its edges and a radius as the transcription reads it: the bold strokes are a V from the top side down to the centre). Below left: a cube in perspective (light strokes) with a flag (vertex, edge, face) in bold and three lines labelled sigma_0, sigma_1, sigma_2 fanning out to the right. The chain of formulas beside it is text.

drawings.description: Plus bas, « $x_0$ --- $x_{n-1}$ » au-dessus d'un segment gradué fléché, dont les deux premiers intervalles sont repassés en gras.
drawings.kind: graduated segment
drawings.notes: x_0 --- x_{n-1} above a graduated segment, its first two intervals inked heavy; no arrowhead is visible at the right end on the crop (the transcription says "flêché"). Same bbox as 07-1 (same region of p. 123).
